title: Enterprise Connectivity: currency
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following currency for each named contract tier. Invoice and settlement currency; ISO currency string.

| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | currency | USD |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | currency | USD |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the currency is USD.
